doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Neve's dash is the held Skate (RimewrightKit.in_dash), on the ground and, since owner item 62, in the air (pressed in the air it starts at once). The slide of the Rimelock statue she casts from a skate counts as the skate going on, so skate -> X is a fire (item 64). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source. held_fire.<dash|rmb|e|x|q|all>: {source, ours}: notes for the held-LMB rows (docs only: LMB is a held input everywhere, Hunter.trigger reads the key every frame and fire resumes the frame a slot's lock ends; --held-fire-resume-check). window.source: the footage evidence for the buffer window (DashFlow.BUFFER_S), shown in docs/heroes/dash_interactions.md. dash_jump.<ground|air|rise|same>: Space in a ground dash, Space in an air dash, Shift in a jump's rise, both on one step: {ours: cancel | both | ignore | end | buffer | dash (measured, --dash-jump-check), carry: share of the dash's speed kept, source, verdict: match | [?] (the source doesn't settle it)}.

lmb.source: Data: Skate is a held mode, released to stop. Footage (0239-0245, 0285-0290): she fires the whole skate and the darts become straight thick beams. Ours: darts fly as beams at normal damage (data pass); the skate goes on.

rmb.source: Data: nothing stops a cast during the held Skate. Footage: not shown. Ours: the spear aim and throw go on while she keeps skating.

e.source: Data: nothing stops a cast during the held Skate. Footage: not shown. Ours: the Rink Wall's tell and slide start while she keeps skating.

x.source: Data: the ult makes her invulnerable inside a slowing zone; footage (ult f25-f55): she is rooted in the crystal. Owner items 64/65: the skate's velocity and direction go on into the ult as a frozen statue that slides on its ice (x.carry_t 0.8 s, easing to a stop, no steering or turning), then she is rooted. Symmetric with item 27 (Shift out of the ult keeps momentum).

glide_rows.source: Owner rule, briefs/DECISIONS.md 2026-11-08: Shift cancels into glide instantly for every Hunter; glide opens only on a press, never a hold. Source rows for this dash: the air dash rows above.
glide_rows.ours: a fresh press ends the dash that step and the glider opens the next, keeping the dash speed up to the handoff cap. The skate ends with the press. Asserted in --airdash-glide-check.

glide_rows.source: Not determinable: no source row for a glide pressed after this Hunter's abilities (data and footage silent). Kept: owner item 162b, no glider inside an ability's animation (docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.md).
